object.name: evi_controlcircuit_buchla
object.digest: Control circuit for voltage control of Rf
object.description: Analog modelled control circuit for the voltage control of the <o>evi_lpg_buchla</o>.gendsp frequency inlet. Also embedded in the MSP abstraction <o>evi.lpg~</o>.

inlets.name: offset
inlets.digest: 0..1 Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

inlets.name: scale
inlets.digest: 0..1 Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

inlets.name: sweep
inlets.digest: 0..1. Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

outlets.name: r_f
outlets.digest: Rf (frequency) voltage, typically to trigger an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) downstream.

attributes.name: control
attributes.description: Select 0, 1, 2. Subtle. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper. It is only noticeable with high control and resonance settings

attributes.name: mapcutoff
attributes.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). Typically this would be set to low Hz values (perhaps 5..20) for maximum effect. This filter mapping is controlled by the @mapdamp attribute and is by default off.

attributes.name: mapdamp
attributes.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped. Under the right settings, this attribute can have a strong affect on the attack feeling of the gate voltage. A higher damping value 'softens' the attack at the filter stage rather than in the envelope stage. This can add a squidgy sound the is rather cool. The mapping filter frequency is set by the @mapcutoff attribute.

attributes.name: offsetsmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'offset' control (inlet 2) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: scalesmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'scale' control (inlet 3) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: sweepsmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'sweep' control (inlet 4) by this amount in ms.
